key_derivation: apps/meteor/server/main.ts imports './settings/definitions' before anything else (with a comment about its top-level await). definitions.ts imports ~37 createXSettings functions from the sibling per-domain files and awaits them in two phases. settings/index.ts constructs `new SettingsRegistry({ store: settings, model: Settings })`, wraps add/addGroup with middleware and awaits initializeSettings —
